subject: Greenleaf POC: proposed success criteria, owners & weekly rhythm
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Subject: Greenleaf POC: proposed success criteria, owners & weekly rhythm

Thanks again for the call earlier — great to meet everyone. Below is a concise post-call recap and a proposed engagement plan so we can lock dates and owners. Please flag anything missing or incorrect.

High-level objective
- Validate that Redwood Inference can serve Greenleaf's real-time reranking/generation workload at target latency and cost while preserving result quality on your sample queries.

Proposed success criteria (finalize at kickoff)
1) Latency: p95 generation latency <= 250ms for 95% of test traffic under the expected concurrency profile (500 concurrent sessions).
2) Cost: average inference cost per 100k tokens delivered aligns with the budgeting envelope you shared (target: <$75 per 100k tokens in the hosted config with caching).
3) Quality: reranking precision (Top-1) >= 86% on the Golden Query Set you provided, with no regression vs baseline.
4) Integration: model endpoint stable with SDK integration and no more than 2 integration issues blocking internal QA.

Evaluation plan
- Data: Greenleaf provides a 1k-sample golden set + 5k synthetic load queries (we'll use the sample for quality gating).
- Runs: baseline evaluation (day 0), two staged runs (midpoint, final).
- Metrics: latency distribution, token cost, Top-1 precision, error rate, and failure logs.

Timeline & milestones (proposed)
- Week 0: paperwork + SOW sign-off (target: by Jun 14)
- Kickoff: Jun 16, 10:00–11:00 PT (30–45m agenda + integrations owners)
- Weeklies: 30–45m syncs every Wednesday (technical check-ins)
- Midpoint readout: Jun 30 — progress on perf/cost and any blockers
- Final readout: Jul 14 — delivery of final metrics, recommended production config

Ownership
- Redwood: Tessa Morgan (CS lead) — program owner; Marissa Cole — operations & runbook; Karthik Iyer — SRE / security liaison & integration support
- Greenleaf: Oliver Khan — product lead; Samantha Rios — technical lead

Next steps (action items)
1) Greenleaf: confirm kickoff date/time and provide the Golden Query Set + data sample by Jun 14 (attachment stub: Greenleaf_data_sample.csv).
2) Redwood: circulate final POC playbook and SOW draft (attached) and prep staging credentials.
3) Internal: Karthik to pick up SOC2/retention questions and confirm data handling flow.

Attachments: POC_playbook_v2.pdf, SOW_Greenleaf_draft.docx

Looking forward — if Jun 16 is tight we can move to Jun 17, but aim to keep the rest of the timeline intact.

Best,
Tessa
